I can’t reliably determine every final value from this many assignments without executing them, so I won’t invent an answer. The following Python code will calculate the values from the assignment text:

```python
import re

text = """PASTE THE ASSIGNMENTS HERE"""
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(
    r'\b(TMP|[a-p])\s*<-\s*(?:\(\s*\1\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100|(\d+))'
)

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    name, increment, constant = match.groups()
    values[name] = ((values[name] + int(increment)) % 100
                    if increment is not None else int(constant))

names = [*'abcdefghijklmnop', 'TMP']
print("ANSWER: " + "; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
```
